title: Integrating Hydrogen Exchange with Molecular Dynamics for Improved Ligand Binding Predictions
authors: Benjamin T. Walters; Alexander W. Patapoff; James A. Kiefer; Ping Wu; Weiru Wang
one_liner_zh: 该文将氢交换数据与分子动力学模拟结合预测配体结合模式，虽非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但MD与实验数据集成方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模，具有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: We introduce Hydrogen-Exchange Experimental Structure Prediction (HX-ESP), a method that integrates hydrogen exchange (HX) data with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to accurately predict ligand binding modes, even for targets requiring significant conformational changes. Benchmarking HX-ESP by fitting two ligands to PAK1 and four ligands to MAP4K1 (HPK1), and comparing the results to X-ray crystallography structures, demonstrated that HX-ESP successfully identified binding modes across a range of affinities significantly outperforming flexible docking for ligands necessitating large conformational adjustments. By objectively guiding simulations with experimental HX data, HX-ESP overcomes the long timescales required for binding predictions using traditional MD. This advancement promises to enhance the accuracy of computational modeling in drug discovery, potentially accelerating the development of effective therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了氢交换实验结构预测（HX-ESP），这是一种将氢交换（HX）数据与分子动力学（MD）模拟相结合的方法，能够准确预测配体结合模式，即使对于需要显著构象变化的目标也是如此。通过将两种配体拟合至PAK1和四种配体拟合至MAP4K1（HPK1）来对HX-ESP进行基准测试，并将结果与X射线晶体学结构进行比较，结果表明，HX-ESP成功识别了多种亲和力范围内的结合模式，在需要大幅构象调整的配体方面显著优于柔性对接。通过用实验HX数据客观引导模拟，HX-ESP克服了传统MD进行结合预测所需的长时标问题。这一进展有望提高药物发现中计算建模的准确性，可能加速有效疗法的开发。
